title: Learning Causal Normalizing Flows from Incomplete Data via Observed-Data Likelihood
abstract: arXiv:2609.37664v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Causal Normalizing Flows (CNFs) enable causal inference from observational data given the causal structure, but they assume fully observed training data. We introduce MissCNF, which trains CNFs directly on incomplete data by maximizing the marginal likelihood of each partially observed sample, without discarding rows or constructing a completed dataset. Thanks to the causal structure encoded in the autoregressive factorization of CNFs, only missing variables in the ancestral closure of the observed set are integrated out, while the others are dropped without computation. We further establish the conditions under which MissCNF recovers the true joint distribution, and introduce \emph{causal-family positivity}, where identification is possible even when no record in the dataset is ever complete. translated_title: 基于观测数据似然从不完整数据中学习因果归一化流
translated_abstract: 因果归一化流（CNF）能够在给定因果结构的前提下从观测数据中进行因果推断，但其假设训练数据是完全被观测的。我们提出了 MissCNF，该方法通过最大化每个部分观测样本的边际似然，直接在不完整数据上训练 CNF，而无需丢弃数据行或构建补全后的数据集。得益于 CNF 自回归分解中编码的因果结构，只需对观测变量集合的祖先闭包中的缺失变量进行积分，其余缺失变量则无需计算即可省略。我们进一步建立了 MissCNF 能够恢复真实联合分布的条件，并提出了“因果族正性”这一概念，在该条件下即使数据集中不存在任何完整记录，识别依然可行。我们将 MissCNF 与两种常见的缺失数据处理策略进行了比较：逐行删除法和先插补后拟合的流程。在八个合成数据集上的实验表明……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 MissCNF 方法，通过最大化部分观测样本的边际似然，直接在不完整数据上训练因果归一化流，无需删行或插补即可进行因果推断，并给出了恢复真实联合分布的条件及“因果族正性”下可识别的新情形。
en_tdlr: We propose MissCNF, which trains causal normalizing flows directly on incomplete data by maximizing the marginal likelihood of partially observed samples, enabling causal inference without listwise deletion or imputation, with new conditions for recovering the true joint distribution.
